description: Job Title: Business Analyst/QA Specialist Job Description The Business Analyst/QA Specialist plays a key role in translating business, user, and product needs into clear, actionable requirements that support software and platform development in a complex, compliance-driven environment. This position partners closely with product, engineering, and quality assurance teams to ensure requirements are technically sound, testable, and fully traceable across the system lifecycle. Responsibilities Elicit, analyze, and document business, user, and product requirements that capture functional, non-functional, and compliance-related needs. Partner with Product Owners, Engineering, and QA teams to ensure requirements are technically sound, testable, and interconnected across systems. Analyze how requirements impact one another and identify dependencies, constraints, and interactions within integrated system components. Ensure compliance-driven and policy-related requirements are accurately reflected and traceable throughout the system lifecycle. Support QA processes by linking requirements to test cases and validation criteria to achieve complete coverage and end-to-end traceability. Maintain organized, high-quality documentation across Jira, Confluence, and related collaboration and tracking tools. Facilitate requirement review sessions to confirm accuracy, resolve ambiguities, and promote shared understanding across delivery teams. Interpret data flows, system integrations, and functional dependencies to inform requirement design and impact analysis. Collaborate with stakeholders from both technical and business domains to align requirements with strategic objectives and user needs. Essential Skills Minimum of 5 years of experience as a Business Analyst or Systems Analyst supporting software or platform development. Bachelors degree in Business, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. Proven experience in requirements gathering and documentation across business, user, and product domains. Strong understanding of how business, user, and product requirements interrelate within complex system environments. Technical fluency sufficient to interpret data flows, system integrations, and functional dependencies. Experience supporting QA workflows and maintaining requirements-to-test-case traceability. Exceptional analytical skills with the ability to break down complex problems and define clear, structured requirements. Strong communication skills with the ability to bridge technical and business audiences and facilitate collaborative discussions. Ability to ensure compliance and security-related requirements are incorporated into system design and documentation. Additional Skills & Qualifications Proficiency with Jira and Confluence for requirements management, documentation, and collaboration. Experience supporting government programs or compliance-driven software delivery initiatives. Knowledge of NIST standards, FedRAMP

Job Title: Project Controls Analyst Job Description The Project Controls Analyst supports project managers and project controls functions across construction-related projects, serving as a critical member of the project team. This role ensures that financial documentation, subcontractor invoices, project budgets, and client invoicing packages are accurate, complete, and ready for management review. The position offers high visibility into project financial management and provides a strong foundation for career growth in project controls, project management, cost engineering, commercial management, or construction management. Responsibilities Review subcontractor invoices for accuracy, completeness, and alignment with contract terms. Verify purchase orders, billing periods, and all supporting documentation required for invoicing. Prepare comprehensive invoice packages for project manager review and approval. Support client billing and project invoicing processes to ensure timely and accurate submissions. Validate labor rates, labor categories, and project cost allocations to maintain financial integrity. Assist with budget tracking, including monitoring spending and comparing actuals to budget. Help prepare forecasting and project financial reports to support decision-making and project performance monitoring. Maintain organized and up-to-date project documentation and financial records. Coordinate regularly with project managers, accounting personnel, procurement, construction teams, and subcontractors to gather information and resolve issues. Identify discrepancies related to project costs, invoices, and billing, and take proactive steps to resolve them. Support project cost reporting and financial controls activities to ensure compliance with internal standards. Assist with construction administration and contract administration activities related to billing and documentation. Coordinate subcontractor billing documentation and ensure all required backup documentation is received and complete. Utilize ERP systems and project scheduling tools to support project financial analysis and reporting. Essential Skills Bachelor's degree plus 2 or more years of relevant experience, or Associate degree plus 4 or more years of relevant experience. Strong proficiency with Microsoft Excel, including the ability to work with data, formulas, and reports. Experience reviewing invoices or financial documentation in a professional setting. Understanding of project budgets, cost tracking, and basic project financial processes. Strong attention to detail with the ability to identify discrepancies before they impact project performance. Solid organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple documents, tasks, and deadlines. Effective communication skills for collaborating with project managers, accounting personnel, subcontractors, and other stakeholders. Additional

Job Title: QC Analyst II Job Description The QC Analyst II performs routine and complex analytical testing of pharmaceutical raw materials, in-process samples, finished products, and stability samples in a small pharmaceutical laboratory setting. This role follows cGMP documentation and work instructions with precision, sets up and operates advanced analytical instrumentation, and supports the release and ongoing quality monitoring of intermediates and active pharmaceutical ingredients. The QC Analyst II works with minimal supervision, contributes to technical problem-solving and documentation, and helps ensure compliance with regulatory and internal quality standards. Responsibilities Follow cGMP documentation, procedures, and work instructions accurately and completely for all laboratory activities. Perform routine analytical testing of pharmaceutical raw materials, in-process samples, finished products, and stability samples using established test methods and procedures. Execute routine laboratory functions such as weighing using balances, preparing solutions, pipetting, and using pH meters with an in-depth understanding of these core activities. Perform complex analyses using techniques and instrumentation including appearance testing, FT-IR, UPLC, HPLC, HPLC-ELSD, GC, and GC-HS. Conduct routine testing to support the release of raw materials, intermediates, and APIs, including testing for in-process controls, equipment cleaning verification, reference standard qualification, and stability programs. Perform and assist with the coordination of monthly or quarterly environmental monitoring testing in the laboratory. Coordinate and facilitate the shipment of samples to external vendors for specialized or additional testing. Set up and configure various analytical instruments for testing according to written test methods with little to no supervision. Demonstrate proficiency in operating and troubleshooting HPLC, GC, FT-IR, and related analytical equipment. Plan and execute analytical testing activities independently, ensuring work is completed with minimal supervision. Perform all assigned analyses in a timely, efficient, and organized manner to meet testing and release timelines. Show initiative and interest in learning new analytical techniques, methods, and tests to expand laboratory capabilities. Participate actively in technical discussions and brainstorming sessions to resolve issues and improve laboratory processes. Identify and troubleshoot analytical problems related to instrumentation, general chemistry, test methodologies, and submitted samples. Communicate analytical issues, challenges, and findings clearly to staff and management as needed. Review test data generated by other analysts and witness entries in others laboratory notebooks to support data integrity. Initiate, review, and assist in the completion of technical documentation such as out-of-specification (OOS) and atypical investigations, deviations, and corrective and preve
